note: Starting values from #347, proposed and not approved. Until the maintainer approves this file and sets the workflow's RESOURCE_CHECKS to enforce, the scheduled comparison reports these verdicts and never fails on them. See docs/benchmarks.md#resource-checks.

groups.name: clean_analysis
groups.note: Whole-program analyses with no diagnostics. A median worker allocation more than 5% above the base's fails, and so does an in-handle worker collection where the base had none.

groups.name: query_analysis
groups.note: Analyses with a scope query, a rename's preflight, or one expected diagnostic. The allocation rule is the same; a new in-handle collection warns, as these are not the reviewed clean scenarios.

groups.name: diagnostic_heavy
groups.note: The error-result workload (#240). #347 asks for its own reviewed allowance and proposes none, so it is reported only. The scheduled comparison doesn't run it: its options leave error_result off.

excluded.completion_hit: Answered from the cached analysis; no worker transaction.
excluded.syntax_diagnostic: The server's own parse; no worker transaction.
excluded.typing_burst: Cancelled transactions; not in the scheduled options.
